name: Komeda Coffee Kameari Ekimae
nameJa: 珈琲所コメダ珈琲店 亀有駅前店
description: A roomy full-service Komeda branch right by Kameari station that offers free Komeda Wi-Fi and outlets at a portion of its booth seats, comfortable for a long work session.

name: Starbucks Ario Kameari
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー アリオ亀有店
description: A Starbucks inside the Ario Kameari shopping mall with reliable free Wi-Fi, though outlet availability is not documented and mall-style seating limits its work suitability.

name: Beck's Coffee Shop Shin-Koiwa Ekimae
nameJa: ベックスコーヒーショップ 新小岩駅前店
description: An early-opening station-front Beck's about two minutes from the south exit that provides free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats, handy for a quick pre-work session.

name: Renoir Shin-Koiwa
nameJa: 喫茶室ルノアール 新小岩店
description: A classic Renoir tea room by the north exit, part of a chain known for welcoming long stays with free Wi-Fi and outlets at most tables, well suited to focused laptop work.

name: Doutor Coffee Shin-Koiwa Lumiere
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 新小岩ルミエール店
description: A Doutor in the Shin-Koiwa Lumiere shopping street offering free Doutor Wi-Fi plus USB and outlet charging at some seats, a cheap and convenient spot for short work stints.

name: Doutor Coffee Aoto 3-chome
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 青戸3丁目店
description: A 58-seat Doutor near Keisei Aoto with free Wi-Fi, but two sources agree it has no power outlets, so it works for connectivity yet not for charging a laptop.

name: Doutor Coffee Kanamachi Kitaguchi
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 金町北口店
description: A Doutor by Kanamachi station's north exit whose official listing advertises both free Wi-Fi and power outlets, making it a dependable budget option for remote work.

name: Starbucks Kanamachi Minamiguchi
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 金町駅南口店
address: 6-4-2 Kanamachi, Lavie Claire Kanamachi, Katsushika-ku, Tokyo
description: A Starbucks at Kanamachi station's south exit with standard free Starbucks Wi-Fi and, per customer reports and power-cafe directories, some seats fitted with outlets for working.
